test_title: PYST 38 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:**

The highly anticipated sequel to the blockbuster movie will have been produced by the esteemed director.

options.text: The esteemed director will have produced the highly anticipated sequel to the blockbuster movie.
The esteemed director will produce the highly anticipated sequel to the blockbuster movie.
The esteemed director has produced the highly anticipated sequel to the blockbuster movie.
The esteemed director will be producing the highly anticipated sequel to the blockbuster movie.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence ("...will have been produced by...") is in the **passive voice** (Future Perfect Passive).
 
• To transform it into the **active voice**, the agent following "by" (the esteemed director) becomes the subject.
 
• The verb form must change from "will have been produced" (passive) to **"will have produced"** (active) to maintain the **Future Perfect** tense.
 
• The original subject ("The highly anticipated sequel...") becomes the direct object of the active sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence (Active):** *"The esteemed director will have produced the highly anticipated sequel to the blockbuster movie."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The esteemed director will produce..." – Incorrect tense (Future Simple).
 
• **Option 3: **"The esteemed director has produced..." – Incorrect tense (Present Perfect).
 
• **Option 4: **"The esteemed director will be producing..." – Incorrect tense (Future Continuous).
